correctness.rationale: For each d queried binary points, coordinates produce d-bit columns v_i, edge parity outputs v_i XOR v_j. Zero output forces a duplicate, and distinct columns must cover every nonzero group element by distinct-pair XOR; conversely duplication gives zero and any two-basis yields all outputs. All five explicit two-bases validated. For n=10,d=5 the C(31,8)=7,888,725 translated 9-element candidates were independently exhaustively tested in compiled C++17 with complete XOR bit-mask coverage: none works (NO_NINE_POINT_BASIS_PASS 7888725). Direct replay of actual shattering_trees.json validates all 56 leaf witnesses, n=5 depth3, n=7 depth4, n=9 depth5, and no leaf repeats its hypothesis. Cardinality Ldim<=floor(log2 binom(n,2)), duplicate-signature VC upper bound 2^d<=1+binom(n-1,2), and monotonicity imply the exact VC sequence 0,1,2,2,3,4,4,4,4,5 and Ldim sequence 0,1,2,3,3,4,4,5,5,5 for n=2..11. A complete finite exhaustion proves only this finite obstruction, not all-order dimensions.
